description: Reviewed application Composer runtime source inputs for 3.1.0; exact locked dist bytes plus two manifest-approved local patches and pinned preferred-source supplements.

origin.method: Exact Composer cache ZIP identified by SHA-1 of locked dist URL and pinned Git-root reference; all runtime files matched original dist bytes except the two approved patch outputs. Supplemental downloads matched pinned upstream Git blobs.

additional_source.evidence: Official amphp/process update commit 6810aacc5d7049d9db87e8161e2ef0e66caa1472 identifies v1.2.0; executable Git blobs match the locked package. No reproducible binary rebuild was performed.

upstream_provenance.purpose: Preferred source and current build inputs excluded from Composer dist; supplement runtime source without modifying installed vendor.
limitations: TL232, MTProto, secret-chat, current file-reference-map and all language-generator inputs are included with their generator sources; historical schema sets and complete generated documentation are outside this collection.

Upstream full documentation/RPC error-generation workflows use mutable remote RPC/schema services and a separate development toolchain. Exact historical remote responses and full upstream reproduction are not established; the supplied current TL/language generators were not executed.

No separate LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file was found in the pinned schemas or documentation submodule trees. Original bytes and parent-project notices are retained; no new license is assigned to those upstream inputs.

wrapper_upstream_provenance.delivered_source_policy: Preserve bytes from pinned GitHub source archive, including upstream-requested CRLF. Git blob verification also checked the canonical LF form where needed; no semantic source changes.

excluded: Installed development-tool trees (26 locked packages, including PHPStan PHAR)
Composer-generated vendor/composer metadata, autoloaders and vendor/bin proxies
PHP, SQLite, optional FFmpeg/native codecs and operating-system / Docker-base-image source
Git metadata, live .env, credentials, sessions, databases, WAL/SHM, backups, logs, caches, coverage and prior archives
installation: Install exact composer.lock, apply and verify the two active local patches, then verify every runtime file and preferred-source input before packaging. No generated Composer autoload/bin metadata is included.
limits: Not the full source of a Linux container, external native multimedia libraries or optional development tools.
Retained upstream Windows helper binaries have associated preferred source included, but their rebuild is unverified.

MadelineProto and php-rtc-av metadata/license-header differences are documented without rewriting upstream grants. Retired local UpdateLoop, GeoPoint and formatted-date patches are absent; no claim that every official SDK shutdown behavior is resolved.

findings: Composer metadata declares MIT while the retained LICENSE, PHP headers and pinned README state BSD-3-Clause. Preserve all original texts without silently reconciling the metadata.

All eight checked-in C declaration headers are included verbatim. No separate header generator or extraction recipe exists in the complete pinned AV tree; whether these are directly maintained preferred source or derived output is unestablished. No specific FFmpeg source revision is asserted as their origin.

No FFmpeg, libopus or libvpx native binary is distributed in these RTC packages. The optional FFmpeg downloader was not executed; its PHP-WebRTC/ffmpeg-builder v9.0.1 public repository/tag/release returned 404 during review. External native binary/build scope is not claimed.
